title: Blanc for iPhone App Store Screenshots

heading.text: Blanc for iPhone 1.0 · App Store screenshots, dawn to day

howto.text: Each artboard is one 6.9-inch App Store screenshot (1320 × 2868), in order. Retype a headline or subtitle in place; every caption must pass docs/marketing-claims.md before it goes to Apple. The phone screens are real captures from Blanc for iPhone, made by npm run ios:app-store-screenshots; never draw or edit them. When this canvas changes, ask Claude to pull it into docs/ios/app-store/design/ and re-render the 6.9-inch and 6.3-inch sets.
